newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-DAVIES TO DEFEND TITLE AT LPGA CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-DAVIES TO DEFEND TITLE AT LPGA CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Laura Davies goes after her third LPGA Championship in four years when she opens defence of her title at the $1.2 million LPGA Championship at the Du Pont Country Club in the season's second major event.

Davies posted a one-stroke victory over Julie Piers last year in a tournament that was shortened to 54 holes due to rain. The Briton, who has one tournament victory this year and 15 in her career, also won the championship in 1994.
Twenty-nine of the top 30 money winners on the tour are entered including young stars Annika Sorenstam of Sweden and Australian Karrie Webb, the top players on the money list.
The 26-year-old Sorenstam, who leads the money list with $524,260 in 10 events, has won three events and finished runner-up twice.
Webb, 22, has won once and posted runner-up finishes four times.
Other strong contenders include Hall of Famers Patty Sheehan, the last to repeat as champion in 1983, Nancy Lopez, Pat Bradley and Betsy King.
Davies is fourth on the LPGA money list with $258,171.
The Du Pont Country Club is a par-71 layout that spans 6,386 yards. Sheehan set the course record for 18 holes with a 63 in 1984, while the 72-hole record is 267, established by Betsy King in 1992.
